messages:
maria-ops: FYI customer reported a billing mismatch for Dedicated — invoice shows 720 reserved GPU-hours for Mar, but our console/dashboards show ~480 active hours and low token counts. They want an explanation and potential SLA credits.

luis-support: Can you paste their org id + invoice id? Also what's the Dedicated pool config (reserved vs burst)? :thinking:

maria-ops: Org: org-acme-23, invoice: INV-2026-03-17-992. Dedicated pool: 4x A100 reserved, autoscale with 2x burst enabled. Customer says burst shouldn't be billed as reserved, but invoice appears to include burst capacity.

raj-billing: Quick notes — reserved GPU-hours metric is billing.reserved_gpu_hours, active usage is billing.active_gpu_hours, and burst usage is billing.burst_gpu_hours. Invoices are supposed to include reserved + billed burst (per contract) unless burst is in free allowance. I'll check contract terms.

emily-eng: Adding telemetry facts: our infra team has a metric ‘dedicated.node_alloc_events’ and ‘inference.tokens.generated’. For org-acme-23 I see a gap: reserved_gpu_hours=720, active_gpu_hours=482, burst_gpu_hours=238 for March. That math sums to 720 (482+238). So invoice matches metrics, but question is whether burst should be charged.

maria-ops: Customer claims their contract says up to 100 burst hours/month free. We see 238 burst hours billed. Do we have a bug where free-burst allowance not applied?

raj-billing: I pulled the contract: clause 2.3 = "monthly burst allowance: 100 hours free, excess billed at list rate." So we should have discounted first 100 burst hours. If invoice shows full 238 billed at list rate -> problem.

luis-support: Repro steps request from billing team for audit: 1) query billing.events for org-acme-23 between 2026-03-01 and 2026-03-31; 2) export dedicated.metrics for that pool; 3) cross-check invoice line items for burst vs reserved. Example query: `SELECT ts, metric, value FROM billing.events WHERE org_id='org-acme-23' AND month='2026-03' ORDER BY ts;`

emily-eng: Ran queries — raw event export attached (snippet):
```
ts=2026-03-12T03:01Z metric=burst_gpu_hours value=18.0
ts=2026-03-20T14:12Z metric=burst_gpu_hours value=40.0
... total burst=238.0
```
We also have a post-processor job that applies contract discounts (billing.apply_contract_discounts). That job shows an error on 2026-03-01: `error: DiscountRuleNotFound: rule_id=burst_allowance_org`. Might explain why allowance wasn't applied.

sre-bot: deploy 2026-02-28-3 removed legacy discount mappings. Ticket ENG-4307 created.

raj-billing: That error means discount rules missing for that org. Two possibilities: discount mapping failed to propagate after deploy, or the org's account metadata changed. We need to decide: 1) patch billing to retro-apply the missing allowance and issue credit; 2) explain to customer and issue SLA credit if appropriate.

luis-support: Customer is upset about a $12k unexpected line item. Can we fast-track a provisional credit while we investigate?

emily-eng: Proposed patch: re-run billing.apply_contract_discounts for March with restored mapping. Steps: 1) rehydrate discount mapping from config backup (s3://infra-backups/discounts/2026-02-27.json); 2) run a dry-run to show corrected invoice lines; 3) if amounts align with contractual expectation, emit credit note and update invoice. I can run the dry-run if billing ops gives OK.

raj-billing: Approve dry-run. If dry-run shows removal of first 100 burst hours at 0 cost, we'll issue credit and mark INV-2026-03-17-992 with 'adjusted' flag. Also open customer-facing support doc explaining cause.

maria-ops: I'll message the customer with a brief update: "We've identified a billing rule propagation bug affecting some Dedicated burst allowances. We're running a dry-run and will apply a credit if confirmed. ETA 24 hours." :thumbsup:

luis-support: Follow-ups: capture lessons learned — add a postmortem if credit > $5k, add automated smoke test to billing.apply_contract_discounts on each deploy.

emily-eng: Action items assigned: emily-eng will run dry-run (started), raj-billing will draft credit once dry-run completes, maria-ops will update customer thread, luis-support will create incident/PM for automation. I'll paste dry-run output here when done.

maria-ops: Thank you all. tagging ENG-4307 and BILL-772 for visibility.

(End of thread)
